text: Pruning, watering, and observing are essential practices for maintaining a healthy garden. Pruning helps to remove dead or damaged branches, encouraging new growth and improving air circulation, which can prevent disease and pests. Regular watering is crucial to keep plants hydrated and healthy, especially during dry spells. Observing your garden can help you identify any issues early, such as signs of disease or nutrient deficiencies, allowing you to take prompt action to prevent further damage. By following these simple yet effective practices, you can enjoy a bountiful harvest of fresh produce from your garden.
summary: Pruning, watering, and observing ensure a healthy garden with fresh produce.
